description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'SearchEngine' within the SuiteCRM project, providing an interface and utility methods for search engine implementations, including methods for performing searches, displaying forms and results, and validating queries.

classes.name: SearchEngine
classes.description: An abstract class providing the interface and utility methods for search engine implementations within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Abstract method to perform a search with a given SearchQuery and return SearchResults.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search and displays the search form and results if the query is not empty.

methods.name: displayForm
methods.description: Displays the default search form using SearchFormController.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the SearchQuery; trims whitespace by default, throws exception if invalid.
